messages:
elaine_sales: Rapid ask from Nimbus — 2-week POC. Needs billing project, $2k hard spend cap, 14 days of trial credits, scoped expiring API keys, and optional VPC peering. Can we stand this up by next Monday?

mike_se: Yes. Standard steps: create billing org -> project -> attach spendshield -> grant promo credits -> issue ephemeral project keys. Dedicated/GPU/VPC require infra ticket.

priya_finops: We can provide 14d promo credits up to $1,200 and set a $2,000 hard spendshield. Promo credits apply first. Manager approval required for credits > $1k. No auto-charge beyond cap.

elaine_sales: Sales will cover $1.2k credits. Customer won't share payment method for the trial. I'll collect billing contact.

omar_infra: For VPC peering we need CIDR and peering contact; for Dedicated we need expected rps, model family, and region. We can propose a temporary dedicated-burst if capacity exists.

mike_se: Nimbus estimates 30 req/s, ~900 tokens/sec aggregate, open-medium family, prefer us-west-2 but can use us-east-1. They want peering only if latency requires it.

dev-bot: infra/5566 created: "Nimbus POC - temp dedicated + optional VPC" assigned to omar_infra. ETA: 48h for capacity check. finance/5567 queued: "Nimbus promo credits $1200 + spendshield $2000" pending priya_finops.

priya_finops: I'll route the $1.2k approval. Need legal company name + billing contact email to create billing org.

elaine_sales: I'll send contact: jared@nimbusai.io and Nimbus AI, Inc. Action items: Priya approve credits; Omar confirm infra; Mike to issue ephemeral key and quickstart; I'll notify customer and target Monday kickoff. Thanks :)
